# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 1.0.x | yes |
| older | no |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately using [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/duhman/pdfview/security/advisories/new) for this repository.

Do not open public issues for exploitable vulnerabilities.

Include:

- Affected version or commit
- Steps to reproduce
- Impact assessment
- Suggested fix (if you have one)

We aim to acknowledge reports within a few business days.

## Scope

PDFView is a sandboxed, local-only macOS app. Reports about missing certificate-based PDF signatures or cloud sync are out of scope unless they describe a sandbox escape, unauthorized file access, or similar security defect.
